judgments.rationale: The source text states that the written notice must be sent 'unless the following information is contained in the initial communication or the consumer has paid the debt', creating disjunctive exceptions. The proposed edit replaces this with a conjunctive requirement ('unless both the information is contained in the initial communication and the consumer has paid the debt'), which directly alters the statutory standard and contradicts the source.

source_spans.quote: (a) Notice of debt; contents Within five days after the initial communication with a consumer in connection with the collection of any debt, a debt collector shall, unless the following information is contained in the initial communication or the consumer has paid the debt, send the consumer a written notice containing—
